detail: R-the-rule-writer-still-reaches-directorie-c816: The rule writer still reaches directories the take-back never walks: `RULES_SKIP` names, symlinks (found 2026-10-25 by T-2026-10-25-006; the `./` spellings closed by T-2026-10-25-007)

data.title: The rule writer still reaches directories the take-back never walks: `RULES_SKIP` names, symlinks (found 2026-10-25 by T-2026-10-25-006; the `./` spellings closed by T-2026-10-25-007)
data.label: KNOWN FACT
data.what: KNOWN FACT (each reproduced on disk by the T-2026-10-25-006 review, all pre-existing on HEAD):
data.likelihood: needs an unusual `dirs:` entry — rare; a stale rule keeps steering agents there with nothing reporting it.
data.fix: give the writer the walk's skips — a `block` target with a `RULES_SKIP` component or a symlinked directory on its way gets a hint, not a write; have adopt's `report()` print `plan.hints`.
data.status_why: unwalked_dir: writer skips RULES_SKIP names and symlinked dirs (case residual filed separately) (T-2026-10-30-2223 B2)

detail: R-the-installer-checks-python3-exists-not-ca45: The installer checks python3 exists, not that it is 3.11+

detail: R-a-suite-that-writes-an-untracked-artifac-0855: A suite that writes an untracked artifact moves the tree on every run (found 2026-10-26 by the T-2026-10-25-008 review, N6, out of scope)

data.title: A suite that writes an untracked artifact moves the tree on every run (found 2026-10-26 by the T-2026-10-25-008 review, N6, out of scope)
data.label: INFERENCE
data.what: INFERENCE — a suite that leaves `.coverage`, `junit.xml` or another untracked, non-ignored file behind moves the tree on every run, so no run ever stands for a tree and fact (a) is never green.
data.likelihood: any project whose test runner writes reports into the tree without a `.gitignore` entry; every schema-7 task there needs a review.
data.fix: name the artifact in the "tree moved" line so the human adds it to `.gitignore`, or snapshot only tracked files plus the task's own files.
data.status_why: verify names the changed paths and marks untracked ones on a moved tree (T-2026-10-30-2223 B2)
